# Braced expressions

A braced expression in a paragraph: {someValue} renders as literal inline code.

Inside a link: [a {braced} link](https://example.com).

Inside a link target: [text](https://example.com/{id}).

Nested braces: {a && {b: 1}} and {`a template ${literal}`}.

An unbalanced brace: {unclosed

A brace inside inline code: `{not an expression}`.

In a table cell:

| Expression | Result |
|---|---|
| {count} | literal |
